The cerebellum is part of the central ne.why: Rarely stated as such: the cerebellum is described as part of the brain (hindbrain), and the brain as part of the central nervous system. Exact forms of the fact occur 14 times in Dolma against 1.18 million mentions of the cerebellum; nearby co-occurrence with 'central nervous system' is 2.3% of its mentions, and the sampled hits are research text that mentions both without stating the fact. It follows from the two premises by transitivity of 'part of'. Weaker evidence than the nephron's (some exact hits), but still 'likely'.
